records.title: Research handoff observation
records.summary: Example pointer for retaining full source context during research handoff; not a promoted method.
records.applies_when: A research run captures a long discussion.
records.does_not_apply_when: No source context has been captured or verified.

records.title: Video handoff observation
records.summary: Example pointer for shot, asset, edit and render decisions during video handoff; not a promoted method.
records.applies_when: An edit run changes source assets or render settings.
records.does_not_apply_when: Only unrelated research notes are in scope.

records.title: Translation handoff observation
records.summary: Example pointer for terminology, register and rejected renderings during translation handoff; not a promoted method.
records.applies_when: A translation run makes terminology decisions.
records.does_not_apply_when: No translation content or style decision exists.
